_about: Sea step 13 R2g: region 2's PITCH POTS (game/sea_pitch_pots.gd): clay pots under spouts in mangrove roots on the islands (sea x, z; the ground under them found by a ray). [F] at a full pot (within reach_m) gives give = [min, max] of item; the pot fills again regrow_s later. Each player taps his own pots (no host, nothing saved: a pot is full again after a restart). Drawn within show_m. ALL PLACES AND NUMBERS ARE MY PLACEHOLDERS.
